senses.gloss:
ITA-8.2.34 ambuvargaḥ/jalavargaḥ अम्बुवर्गः/जलवर्गः
Group of various types of processed and unprocessed water
The group of various types of processed and unprocessed water such as rainwater, water from wells, lakes and rivers, coconut water and boiled water.

ITA-2.5.8 Udakavahasrotaḥ, ambuvahasrotaḥ, ambumārgaḥ उदकवहस्रोतः,अम्बुवहस्रोतः, अम्बुमार्गः
Channel, pathway for fluid circulation
Pathways which refer to water balance in the body.
